rag.answer:
Uber reported **118 million MAPCs in Q4 2021** in its FY2021 Form 10-K.[1]

For **Q2 2026**, Uber reported **218 million MAPCs**.[2]

**Growth from Q4 2021 to Q2 2026:**

- Absolute increase: **218 − 118 = 100 million MAPCs**
- Percentage growth: **100 ÷ 118 = 84.7%**
- In other words, MAPCs increased by approximately **85%**, or **1.85×**.

[1] [Uber FY2021 Form 10-K—operational metrics](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1543151/000154315122000009/uber-20211231.htm)  
[2] [Uber Q2 2026 earnings release](https://investor.uber.com/news-events/news/uber-announces-results-for-second-quarter-2026/)

- **Absolute growth:** 208 million − 118 million = **90 million MAPCs**
- **Percentage growth:** 90 ÷ 118 × 100 = **76.27%**, or approximately **76.3%**
